section.content: 本实用新型公开了一种基因工程生物培养箱，涉及培养箱技术领域，包括培养箱，培养箱两侧内壁均固定连接有固定轨，培养箱的内壁两侧固定连接有多个固定轨，放置板的外表面紧贴于固定轨的内侧，固定轨的内侧固定连接有限位柱，培养箱的内腔中部设置有多个放置板，培养箱的内壁一侧固定安装有温度探头，培养箱的内顶壁固定安装有箱灯，该基因工程生物培养箱，通过在培养箱箱体内设置的箱灯和培养箱箱体一侧设置的箱灯门控开关，当箱门处于关闭时，使培养箱内腔的箱灯处于工作常亮状态，便于工作人员通过箱门的玻璃框观察培养箱内腔,当箱门处于打开时，使培养箱内腔的箱灯处于不工作状态，节约资源，提高了培养箱自动化的效果。

The utility model discloses a genetic engineering biological incubator, which relates to the technical field of incubators and comprises an incubator, wherein fixed rails are fixedly connected on the inner walls of the two sides of the incubator, a plurality of fixed rails are fixedly connected on the two sides of the inner wall of the incubator, the outer surface of a placing plate is clung to the inner sides of the fixed rails, a limiting column is fixedly connected on the inner sides of the fixed rails, a plurality of placing plates are arranged in the middle of the inner cavity of the incubator, a temperature probe is fixedly arranged on one side of the inner wall of the incubator, and an incubator lamp is fixedly arranged on the inner top wall of the incubator, the genetic engineering biological incubator is characterized in that the incubator lamp of the inner cavity of the incubator is in a normally bright working state when the incubator door is closed, so that workers can observe the inner cavity of the incubator through a glass frame of the incubator door, and the incubator lamp of the inner cavity of the incubator is in an out-of-working state when the incubator door is opened, resources are saved, and the automation effect of the incubator is improved.

Biological incubator of genetic engineeringTechnical Field

The utility model relates to an incubator technical field specifically is a genetic engineering biological incubator.

Background

The biological incubator has the temperature controllable function of a refrigeration and heating bidirectional temperature regulation system, is one of indispensable laboratory equipment of plant, organism, microorganism, heredity, virus, environmental protection and other scientific research and teaching departments, is widely applied to constant temperature tests, culture tests, environmental experiments and the like, and plays a significant role in scientific research, environmental protection, sewage treatment and other departments.

Most incubator box need often shine the illumination in actual operating condition, still often light when the chamber door is opened, extravagant power, manual switch case lamp is inconvenient, and biological incubator needs last the power supply, still needs manual switching power when having a power failure, probably cultivates to cause not good influence to the culture at the power failure in-process.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

Technical problem to be solved

The utility model provides a not enough to prior art, the utility model provides a genetic engineering biological incubator, the current genetic engineering biological incubator who has proposed in having solved above-mentioned background art needs often to brighten the illumination at most incubator box in actual operating condition, still often brighten when the chamber door is opened, extravagant power, manual switch case lamp is inconvenient, biological incubator needs to last the power supply, still need manual switching power when having a power failure, probably cultivate the problem that causes the not good influence to the culture at the power failure in-process.

(II) technical scheme

In order to achieve the above purpose, the utility model discloses a following technical scheme realizes:

a genetic engineering biological incubator comprises an incubator, wherein fixed rails are fixedly connected to the inner walls of two sides of the incubator, a limiting column is fixedly connected to one surface of each two adjacent fixed rails, a plurality of placing plates are installed in the inner cavity of the incubator, a temperature probe is fixedly installed on one side of the inner wall of the incubator, an incubator lamp is fixedly installed on the inner top wall of the incubator, a dustproof net is fixedly installed on two sides of the incubator, a filter screen is fixedly installed on two sides of the inner wall of the incubator, a standby power supply is fixedly installed on one side of the bottom of the inner cavity of the incubator, a dual-power automatic transfer switch is fixedly installed on the other side of the bottom of the inner cavity of the incubator, a incubator lamp door control switch is fixedly installed on one side of a frame of the incubator, a limiting block is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the incubator lamp door control switch, and a limiting groove is formed in one side of the frame of the incubator, the both sides of incubator have all been seted up and have been placed the through-hole, the inboard fixed mounting who places the through-hole has the fixed plate, one side fixedly connected with motor of fixed plate, one side swing joint of motor has the pivot, the one end fixed mounting of pivot has the flabellum.

Furthermore, a hinge is fixedly installed on one side of the incubator body, a chamber door is arranged on the front face of the incubator, the incubator door is movably connected with the incubator through the hinge, and a transparent glass frame is fixed in the middle of the chamber door.

Further, the fixed rails are provided with three groups, wherein four fixed rails are a group, and the end of the placing plate is located between two adjacent fixed rails.

Furthermore, one end of the rotating shaft, which is far away from the motor, penetrates through the middle of the fixing plate, and ventilation holes are formed in the surface of the fixing plate.

(III) advantageous effects

The utility model provides a genetic engineering biological incubator possesses following beneficial effect:

1. this genetic engineering biological incubator, through the case lamp that sets up in the incubator box and the case lamp door control switch that incubator box one side set up, when the chamber door is in when closing, make the case lamp of incubator inner chamber be in the normal bright state of work, the staff of being convenient for observes the incubator inner chamber through the glass frame of chamber door, when the chamber door is in when opening, makes the case lamp of incubator inner chamber be in out of work state, resources are saved has improved the automatic effect of incubator.

2. This two power automatic transfer switch thing incubators are given birth to genetic engineering, through stand-by power supply and two power automatic transfer switch that set up in the incubator bottom, make the incubator can be timely under the power failure state switch to stand-by power supply, reached the effect of continuous power supply, shortened the incubator greatly and be in the time of power failure state, reduced the cultivation risk of culture, avoided the external influence that the power failure caused the culture.

The theory of operation, this genetic engineering biological incubator at first opens external power supply, opens chamber door 11, then puts into 1 inner chamber of incubator with the culture, closes chamber door 11 and drives case lamp gating switch 14, makes case lamp 6 be in the normal bright state of work, and when external power supply outage, dual supply automatic transfer switch 10 work, with incubator 1 access power supply switching to stand-by power supply 9, when external power supply normal power supply, dual supply automatic transfer switch 10 switches incubator 1 access power supply to external power supply.

The electrical components presented in the document are all electrically connected with an external master controller and 220V mains, and the master controller can be a conventional known device controlled by a computer or the like.
